pr_title: sql: add PartialIndexMutator for generating random partial indexes
pr_body:
This commit adds `PartialIndexMutator` for generating random partial
indexes for randomized tests. The mutator is enabled for sqlsmith in
this commit. Once the temporary `experimential_partial_indexes` session
setting is removed, the mutation should be run for every invocation of
`RandCreateTable`, similar to `IndexStoringMutator`.

Fixes #52030

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/52204)

issue_context.title: sql: add partial indexes to table randomizer
issue_context.body:
* Random build partial indexes
* Enable them for certain tests, like sqlsmith
* Write a randomized CREATE TABLE LIKE test

More context: #51849

review_comments: Can this stuff go away now due to SerializeForDisplay?
Unfortunately, no. `SerializeForDisplay` adds type annotations for literals, and statistics must be `:::JSONB` not `:::STRING`
It looks like it's possible that none of the column types are are useable, in which case e will be nil.

This should be fine, because a `nil` `Predicate` indicates a non-partial index. I guess it may be confusing that this function returns nil when called, but it shouldn't break anything. I've added a comment to the function to call this out, but if there's something else you think is more appropriate, I'm all ears.
